Capabilities

Everything you need on one canvas

Build UI frames, icons, and illustrations with tools that stay close to how designers actually work — without leaving the tab.

  1. 01

    Frames, shapes, and paths

    Rectangles, ellipses, polygons, stars, lines, and a pen tool for custom vector paths — with corner radius, opacity, and precise layout controls.

  2. 02

    Text that sits on the design

    Standard text and text-on-path for logos, labels, and expressive type layouts directly on the canvas.

  3. 03

    Layers you can trust

    Rename, lock, hide, and reorder layers. Select, group, and refine without losing your place in the file.

  4. 04

    Images with AI background removal

    Import images, then remove backgrounds in the browser so cutouts stay in your composition without a separate tool.

  5. 05

    Export when you are ready

    Export PNG for sharing, or JSON to keep a project you can re-open in ClaudeNovo later.

Local-first

Your work stays on your device

Projects live in your browser storage. Editing runs client-side. ClaudeNovo is built so you can design without shipping every file to a remote canvas server.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Short answers for people discovering ClaudeNovo for the first time.

Is ClaudeNovo free?

Yes. ClaudeNovo is free to use in your browser. There is no account required to start designing.

Do my designs leave my computer?

Design projects are stored locally in your browser. Editing features such as background removal run on your device. We do not upload your design files to ClaudeNovo servers for editing.

What can I export?

You can export designs as PNG images and as ClaudeNovo JSON project files you can re-import later.

Is ClaudeNovo a Figma alternative?

ClaudeNovo is a lightweight browser vector editor for frames, shapes, text, layers, and local export. It is designed for fast local design work rather than full multiplayer design systems.
